Q4. 點解 decision tree 嘅 decision boundaries 係 axis-parallel？有咩後果？

因為每個 internal node 只 test 一個 attribute（例如 \(x_1 < 5\)），所以每條 boundary 都垂直於某條軸。如果真正 boundary 係斜線或者 class 取決於 attributes 之間嘅 interaction，tree 要用大量 splits 去近似（樓梯形），容易變得複雜同 overfit（slides 36–38）。

Q5. KNN 中 \( k \) 太細同太大各有咩問題？點解要 scale attributes？

\( k \) 太細 → 對 noise points 敏感；\( k \) 太大 → neighborhood 會包含其他 class 嘅點。要 scale 係因為 attributes 範圍唔同（例如 income $10K–$1M vs height 1.5–1.8m），唔 scale 嘅話 distance 被範圍最大嘅 attribute 主導。

Q6. 用本頁稅務 data，用 Naïve Bayes 分類 \( X = (\text{Refund} = \text{No}, \text{Married}, \text{Income} = 120\text{K}) \)。

\( P(X \mid \text{No}) = P(\text{Refund}=\text{No} \mid \text{No}) \times P(\text{Married} \mid \text{No}) \times P(120 \mid \text{No}) = 4/7 \times 4/7 \times 0.0072 = 0.00235 \)；\( \times P(\text{No})\ 0.7 = 1.6 \times 10^{-3} \)。
\( P(X \mid \text{Yes}) = 1 \times P(\text{Married} \mid \text{Yes}) \times \dots = 1 \times \) 0/3 \( \times \dots = \) 0。
→ 分類為 No。留意 \( P(\text{Married} \mid \text{Yes}) = 0 \) 令 Yes 嘅概率直接變 0——就係 zero-probability issue，可用 Laplace smoothing 修正。

Q7. 「Naïve」指咩假設？舉一個 conditional independence 例子。邊類 attributes 會令佢失效？

假設 given class 時 attributes 互相 conditionally independent：\( P(X_1 \ldots X_d \mid Y) = \prod P(X_i \mid Y) \)。例：arm length 同 reading skills 係 conditionally independent given age。Redundant / correlated attributes 會違反呢個假設（slide 67）。

Q8. SVM 點解要 maximize margin？寫出 optimization problem。邊啲點決定 decision boundary？

Margin 大 → generalization 較好、對 noise 更 robust、減少 overfitting。Problem：minimize \( \|w\|^2/2 \) subject to \( y_i(w\cdot x_i + b) \ge 1 \) for all \( i \)（等價於 maximize \( 2/\|w\| \)）。用 Lagrange multipliers 解；decision boundary 只取決於 support vectors（\(\lambda_i > 0\) 嘅點）。

Q9. 一個 linear SVM 有 \( w = (2, -1) \)、\( b = 1 \)。分類 \( x = (1, 4) \) 同 \( x = (0, 0) \)，並計 margin。

(1, 4)：\( 2 - 4 + 1 = -1 < 0 \) → −1。(0, 0)：\( 0 + 0 + 1 = 1 \ge 0 \) → +1。\( \text{Margin} = 2/\|w\| = 2/\sqrt{5} = \) 0.894。

Q10. 邊個 classifier：(a) prediction 最慢 (b) training 最慢 (c) 對 redundant attributes 最差 (d) 係 lazy learner？

(a) KNN (b) SVM (c) Naïve Bayes（very poor）(d) KNN（Instance, Lazy）。

一頁總結 Cheat sheet

⭐ 考前速記
  • Classification：record \( (x, y) \)；learn model \( x \to \) predefined \( y \)；training set 建 model，test set 量 accuracy。
  • Decision tree：root → internal (attribute test) → leaf (class)；分類只行一條路徑。Algorithms：Hunt's、CART、ID3/C4.5、SLIQ/SPRINT。
  • Hunt's：\(D_t\) 同一 class → leaf；否則用 attribute test split，recursive。
  • Test conditions：nominal（multi-way / binary subsets）、ordinal（binary 要保持 order）、continuous（discretize static/dynamic，或 binary \( A < v \)，試所有 cuts）。
  • Impurity：\( \text{Gini} = 1 - \sum p^2 \)（max 0.5 for 2-class）；\( \text{Entropy} = -\sum p \log_2 p \)（max 1）；\( \text{Error} = 1 - \max p \)（max 0.5）。
  • \( \text{Gain} = P - M \)，\( M = \sum (n_j/n)\, I(\text{child}_j) \)；揀 gain 最大 / \( M \) 最細。Entropy 版 = Information Gain。
  • 例：Gini parent 0.42；Refund M 0.343；Marital M 0.300；Income \( \le 97.5 \) M 0.300。
  • Stop：same class / identical attributes / early termination；pre-pruning、post-pruning。
  • DT 優：平、快、易解釋（細 tree）、robust to noise、handle redundant / irrelevant；缺：greedy 未必最佳、唔考慮 interactions、boundary 只涉及單一 attribute（axis-parallel）。
  • KNN：labeled records + distance metric + \( k \)；majority vote 或 \( w = 1/d^2 \)；\( k \) 細 → noise 敏感，\( k \) 大 → 包含其他 class；要 scale（z-score）；local、任意形狀 boundary；irrelevant 加 noise、redundant 加 bias；missing values 令 proximities 不可比。
  • Naïve Bayes：MAP → \( \max P(X \mid Y)P(Y) \)；conditional independence → \( \prod P(X_i \mid Y) \)；categorical = \( n_c/n \)；continuous = discretize 或 Gaussian（\(\mu\), \(\sigma^2\) 用 sample 估）；zero probability 問題（Laplace \( (n_c+1)/(n+c) \)）；robust to noise / irrelevant，missing 可忽略，redundant 違反假設。
  • SVM：max margin \( 2/\|w\| \) ⇔ min \( \|w\|^2/2 \) s.t. \( y_i(w\cdot x_i+b) \ge 1 \)；Lagrange multipliers；boundary 只靠 support vectors；predict \( \text{sign}(w\cdot x+b) \)；slack \( \xi_i \) + \( C \sum \xi_i^k \)；convex → global optimum；training 慢；robust；handle irrelevant / redundant；難處理 missing。
  • Summary：DT Tree/Eager；KNN Instance/Lazy；NB Probabilistic/Eager；SVM Geometric/Eager。

title: Classification (II): Overfitting, Model Evaluation & Imbalanced Classes
meta: COM6004 · Chapter 4B · Source: COM6004_Chapter_4B_Classification_(II).pptx (58 slides) · Underfitting & Overfitting, Model Evaluation, Imbalanced Class Problem

headings.text: 7. Precision, Recall, F-measure & 其他 Measures

html:
🎯 本講重點 (Learning outcomes)

  • 分辨 training error、test error、generalization error；解釋 underfitting 同 overfitting 同 model complexity / training size 嘅關係。
  • 理解 model selection：validation set、Occam's Razor。
  • 由 confusion matrix 計 Accuracy、Precision、Recall、F-measure、TPR、TNR、FPR、FNR；計 classification cost。
  • 比較 Holdout、Random subsampling、k-fold / Leave-one-out / Repeated / Stratified cross-validation。
  • 由 classifier scores 構建 ROC curve，理解 AUC 同用 ROC 比較 models。
  • 理解 class imbalance 問題同處理方法：class-based ordering、cost-sensitive classification、sampling。

⭐ 考試必溫 Top-5

  1. Confusion matrix \( (a = TP, b = FN, c = FP, d = TN) \) 同所有 metrics 公式；slides 46–50 嘅數字例子。
  2. Accuracy 喺 imbalanced data 會誤導（9990 vs 10 例子）。
  3. Cost matrix 計算（M1 accuracy 80% cost 3910 vs M2 accuracy 90% cost 4255）同 cost-sensitive decision（sick / healthy 例子）。
  4. ROC：軸（TPR vs FPR）、特殊點 (0,0)、(1,1)、(0,1) ideal、diagonal = random；構建步驟；\( AUC = 1 \) ideal、0.5 random。
  5. Underfitting vs Overfitting 定義；validation set ≠ test set；k-fold CV 同 stratified CV。

1. Classification Errors

ExamSlide 4：

Error 類型定義
Training errors（apparent errors）Errors committed on the training set
Test errorsErrors committed on the test set
Generalization errorsExpected error of a model over random selection of records from same distribution（真正關心嘅嘢，只能估計）

1.1 Example Data Set (Slides 5–9)

Two-class problem：

  • +：5400 instances——5000 個由中心 (10, 10) 嘅 Gaussian 產生，另加 400 個 noisy instances。
  • o：5400 instances，由 uniform distribution 產生。
  • 10% 用作 training，90% 用作 testing。

Slides 6–9 比較 nodes 數目唔同嘅 decision trees：4 nodes 嘅 tree boundary 好簡單；50 nodes 嘅 tree 喺 training data 上畫出好多細碎 boundaries（連 noise 都 fit 埋）。Slide 9 問："Which tree is better?"

🖼️ 圖片內容

Slides 5–9 嘅散點圖、trees 同 decision boundaries，以及 slides 10–12 嘅 error curves 全部係圖片；請對照原 slide。

2. Underfitting & Overfitting

Slide 10：As the model becomes more and more complex, test errors can start increasing even though training error may be decreasing.

⭐ 考試重點：定義
  • Underfitting：when model is too simple, both training and test errors are large.
  • Overfitting：when model is too complex, training error is small but test error is large.
Model complexity（例如 tree nodes 數）Training errorTest error狀態
好低（例如 1–4 nodes）高高Underfitting
適中中低最低Just right
好高（例如 50+ nodes）極低（近 0）上升Overfitting
💡 直覺理解

Overfitting 好似學生死背 past paper 答案（連 typo 都背埋）——past paper（training set）攞滿分，但新題目（test set）就唔識。50-node tree 將 400 個 noisy points 都當成真 pattern 去 fit，所以喺新 data 上反而錯更多。

2.1 Impact of Training Data Size (Slides 11–12)

Using twice the number of data instances：Increasing the size of training data reduces the difference between training and testing errors at a given size of model. 即係同一個 50-node tree，用多一倍 training data 訓練，overfitting 會減輕（因為 noise 被更多真實 data「稀釋」）。

2.2 Notes on Overfitting (Slide 13)

  • Overfitting results in decision trees that are more complex than necessary。
  • Training error does not provide a good estimate of how well the tree will perform on previously unseen records。
  • Need ways for estimating generalization errors。

3. Model Selection

Slide 14：Model selection 喺 model building 期間進行，目的係確保 model 唔會 overly complex（避免 overfitting）。要估計 generalization error，方法有：

  • Using Validation Set
  • Incorporating Model Complexity
  • Estimating Statistical Bounds

3.1 Using Validation Set (Slide 15)

將 training data 再分兩部分：

  • Training set：用嚟 model building。
  • Validation set：用嚟估計 generalization error、tune model complexity 同 hyperparameters、model selection 等。

ExamNote: validation set is not the same as test set. Drawback：Less data available for training。

⚠️ 易混淆：Validation vs Test set

Validation set 參與「揀 model / 調 hyperparameter」（例如揀 tree 深度、KNN 嘅 k），所以佢已經間接影響咗 model；Test set 必須完全唔參與任何 training / 選擇過程，最後先用一次去報告最終表現。用 test set 揀 model 會令報告嘅表現過度樂觀。

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
X_tmp, X_test, y_tmp, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=0)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(X_tmp, y_tmp, test_size=0.25, random_state=0)
# 用 (X_tr, X_val) 揀 max_depth；最後先用 X_test 報告一次

3.2 Incorporating Model Complexity (Slide 16)

Rationale：Occam's Razor——Given two models of similar generalization errors, one should prefer the simpler model over the more complex model. 因為 complex model 有更大機會係 accidentally fitted（碰啱 fit 中 noise）。所以評估 model 時應考慮 model complexity（細節 slide 標明 skipped）。

4. Model Evaluation: 三個問題

Slide 18 Purpose：To estimate performance of classifier on previously unseen data (test set)。

  1. Metrics for Performance Evaluation：How to evaluate the performance of a model?
  2. Methods for Performance Evaluation：How to obtain reliable estimates?
  3. Methods for Model Comparison：How to compare the relative performance among competing models?

5. Metrics: Confusion Matrix & Accuracy

Slide 19：Focus on the predictive capability of a model（而唔係速度、scalability 等）。

⭐ 考試重點：Confusion Matrix (Slides 42–43)
ACTUAL CLASSPREDICTED CLASS
Class = YesClass = No
Class = Yes\( a \) (TP)\( b \) (FN)
Class = No\( c \) (FP)\( d \) (TN)

\( a \): TP (true positive)、\( b \): FN (false negative)、\( c \): FP (false positive)、\( d \): TN (true negative)。

$$ \text{Accuracy} = \frac{a + d}{a + b + c + d} = \frac{TP + TN}{TP + TN + FP + FN}, \qquad \text{Error rate} = 1 - \text{Accuracy} $$
💡 記法

第二個字（Positive / Negative）= model 預測咩；第一個字（True / False）= 預測啱定錯。FP = 預測 Positive 但錯咗（實際係 No）；FN = 預測 Negative 但錯咗（實際係 Yes）。

5.1 Limitation of Accuracy (Slides 21, 44)

Exam2-class problem：Class 0 有 9990 個，Class 1 有 10 個。如果 model 將所有嘢預測為 class 0，\( \text{accuracy} = 9990/10000 = \) 99.9%——但 model 一個 class 1 都偵測唔到，所以 accuracy 係 misleading。偵測 rare class 通常先係重點（frauds、intrusions、defects）。

⚠️ Slide 數字留意

Slide 44 寫 "Class 0 = 9990、Class 1 = 10" 但計算寫 "accuracy is 990/1000 = 99%"——數字前後唔一致（應該係 9990/10000 = 99.9%；或者如果係 990 vs 10 就係 99%）。考試照邏輯計：全部預測多數 class 嘅 accuracy = 多數 class 比例。結論一樣：accuracy 高但完全冇用。

6. Cost Matrix & Cost of Classification

Slides 22, 52：\( C(i \mid j) \)：Cost of misclassifying class \( j \) example as class \( i \)（slide 22 記法，即 \( C(\text{predicted} \mid \text{actual}) \)）。Slide 52 表格用 \( C(\text{actual}, \text{predicted}) \) 排列：行 = ACTUAL，列 = PREDICTED。

ACTUALPREDICTED
YesNo
Yes\( C(\text{Yes}, \text{Yes}) \)\( C(\text{Yes}, \text{No}) \)
No\( C(\text{No}, \text{Yes}) \)\( C(\text{No}, \text{No}) \)

總 cost = \( \sum \)（confusion matrix 每格 count × cost matrix 對應格 cost）。

⭐ 考試重點：Slide 53 Computing Cost of Classification

Cost matrix：\( C(+,+) = -1 \)、\( C(+,-) = 100 \)、\( C(-,+) = 1 \)、\( C(-,-) = 0 \)（漏報一個 + 嘅代價 100，極貴）。

Model M1Pred +Pred −
Actual +15040
Actual −60250

\( \text{Accuracy} = (150 + 250)/500 = \) 80%；\( \text{Cost} = 150(-1) + 40(100) + 60(1) + 250(0) = -150 + 4000 + 60 = \) 3910

Model M2Pred +Pred −
Actual +25045
Actual −5200

\( \text{Accuracy} = (250 + 200)/500 = \) 90%；\( \text{Cost} = 250(-1) + 45(100) + 5(1) + 200(0) = -250 + 4500 + 5 = \) 4255

結論：M2 accuracy 較高，但 cost 較高（因為 FN 多咗，而 FN 好貴）→ 以 cost 計 M1 較好。Accuracy 同 cost 可以得出相反結論。

Slide 24 "Cost vs Accuracy"：教科書指出如果 cost matrix 係對稱（\( C(\text{Yes} \mid \text{No}) = C(\text{No} \mid \text{Yes}) = q \)，\( C(\text{Yes} \mid \text{Yes}) = C(\text{No} \mid \text{No}) = p \)），咁 cost 同 accuracy 成線性關係，兩者排名一致；只有 cost 唔對稱時兩者先會分歧。

🖼️ 圖片內容

Slides 22–24 係圖片（cost matrix、computing cost、cost vs accuracy 推導）；slide 24 嘅內容係根據教科書補充，請對照原 slide。Slide 53 嘅表格有文字，已完整收錄。

7. Precision, Recall, F-measure & 其他 Measures

⭐ 考試重點：Alternative Measures (Slides 25, 45, 48)
$$ \text{Precision } (p) = \frac{a}{a + c} = \frac{TP}{TP+FP} \qquad \text{Recall } (r) = \frac{a}{a + b} = \frac{TP}{TP+FN} $$
$$ \text{F-measure } (F) = \frac{2rp}{r + p} = \frac{2a}{2a + b + c} $$
Measure公式意思
TPR（Sensitivity, Recall）\( TP / (TP + FN) \)真正 Yes 之中搵到幾多
TNR（Specificity）\( TN / (TN + FP) \)真正 No 之中正確判 No 幾多
\( FPR = 1 - TNR \)\( FP / (FP + TN) \)假警報率（= \(\alpha\)，Type I error）
\( FNR = 1 - TPR \)\( FN / (FN + TP) \)漏報率（= \(\beta\)，Type II error）
Precision\( TP / (TP + FP) \)預測 Yes 之中真係 Yes 幾多

Slide 25 Cost-Sensitive Measures：

  • Precision is biased towards \( C(\text{Yes} \mid \text{Yes}) \) & \( C(\text{Yes} \mid \text{No}) \)（只涉及「預測 Yes」嗰一列：TP 同 FP）
  • Recall is biased towards \( C(\text{Yes} \mid \text{Yes}) \) & \( C(\text{No} \mid \text{Yes}) \)（只涉及「實際 Yes」嗰一行：TP 同 FN）
  • F-measure is biased towards all except \( C(\text{No} \mid \text{No}) \)（用 TP、FP、FN，唔理 TN）

教科書亦有 \( \text{Weighted Accuracy} = \frac{w_1 a + w_4 d}{w_1 a + w_2 b + w_3 c + w_4 d} \)。

🔗 跨科連繫：Type I / II error (Slide 48)

Slide 48 將 confusion matrix 連去 COM6005 Hypothesis testing：\(\alpha\) = probability that we reject the null hypothesis when it is true → Type I error / false positive (FP)；\(\beta\) = probability that we accept the null hypothesis when it is false → Type II error / false negative (FN)。所以 \( FPR \approx \alpha \)，\( FNR \approx \beta \)，\( TPR = 1 - \beta = \) power。

7.1 Worked examples (Slides 46, 47, 49, 50)

Slide 46（imbalanced：10 Yes vs 990 No）：

Confusion matrix (a, b, c, d)AccuracyPrecisionRecallF
A：TP 10, FN 0, FP 10, TN 980990/1000 = 0.9910/20 = 0.510/10 = 12(0.5)(1)/1.5 = 0.667
B：TP 1, FN 9, FP 0, TN 990991/1000 = 0.9911/1 = 11/10 = 0.12(1)(0.1)/1.1 = 0.182

兩個 model accuracy 差唔多（0.99 vs 0.991），但 A 搵晒所有 Yes，B 只搵到 1 個。F-measure 清楚顯示 A 較好。

Slides 47 / 49（同樣 TPR，唔同 class 比例）：

Confusion matrixAccuracyPrecisionRecall = TPRFPRF
C：TP 40, FN 10, FP 10, TN 400.80.80.810/50 = 0.20.8
D：TP 40, FN 10, FP 1000, TN 40004040/5050 = 0.840/1040 = 0.0380.81000/5000 = 0.20.073

重點：TPR 同 FPR 唔受 class 比例影響（C、D 都係 0.8 / 0.2），但 Precision 對 class imbalance 好敏感（Negative 多 100 倍，FP 都多 100 倍，precision 由 0.8 跌到 0.038）。

Slide 50（三個 models，各 50 Yes、50 No）：

Confusion matrixTPRFPRPrecisionAccuracy
TP 10, FN 40, FP 10, TN 400.20.20.50.5
TP 25, FN 25, FP 25, TN 250.50.50.50.5
TP 40, FN 10, FP 40, TN 100.80.80.50.5

三個 model 都係 \( TPR = FPR \)，即喺 ROC 嘅 diagonal 上 → 同 random guessing 冇分別（只係「估 Yes」嘅比例唔同）。

from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix, classification_report, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score
confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred, labels=[1, 0])   # 排成 [[TP, FN], [FP, TN]]
print(classification_report(y_true, y_pred))

8. Methods for Performance Evaluation

Slide 27：Performance of a model may depend on other factors besides the learning algorithm：Class distribution、Cost of misclassification、Size of training and test sets（slide 圖 learning curve：training size 越大 accuracy 越高同越穩定）。

⭐ 考試重點：Evaluation methods (Slides 28–30)
Method做法優 / 缺
HoldoutReserve 2/3 for training and 1/3 for testing簡單；但用少咗 data train，結果視乎點分
Random subsamplingRepeated holdout，取平均減少隨機性；但某啲 records 可能從未被 test
Cross validation (k-fold)Partition data into \( k \) disjoint subsets；train on \( k - 1 \) partitions，test on the remaining one；重複 \( k \) 次，每個 subset 做一次 test每個 record 都剛好被 test 一次；用晒 data
Leave-one-out\( k = n \)最大化 training data；計算量最大
Repeated cross-validation做幾次 cross-validationGives an estimate of the variance of the generalization error
Stratified cross-validationGuarantee the same percentage of class labels in training and testImportant when classes are imbalanced and the sample is small
💡 3-fold CV 例子 (Slide 29)

Data 分 3 份 \( D_1 \)、\( D_2 \)、\( D_3 \)：Run 1 train \( D_2 + D_3 \)、test \( D_1 \)；Run 2 train \( D_1 + D_3 \)、test \( D_2 \)；Run 3 train \( D_1 + D_2 \)、test \( D_3 \)。最終 error = 三次 test errors 嘅平均（或者將三次 confusion matrices 加埋再計）。例如三次 errors 係 0.10、0.15、0.11 → CV error = 0.12。

🖼️ 圖片內容

Slide 27 嘅 learning curve 同 slide 29 嘅 3-fold CV 示意圖係圖片，請對照原 slide。

from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score, StratifiedKFold, LeaveOneOut, RepeatedStratifiedKFold
cross_val_score(clf, X, y, cv=StratifiedKFold(n_splits=10, shuffle=True, random_state=0))
cross_val_score(clf, X, y, cv=LeaveOneOut())
cross_val_score(clf, X, y, cv=RepeatedStratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, n_repeats=10))  # 可睇 variance

9. ROC Curve (Methods for Model Comparison)

Slide 32：ROC (Receiver Operating Characteristic)：

  • 1950s 為 signal detection theory 分析 noisy signals 而發展。
  • 一個圖像化方法，顯示 detection rate 同 false alarm rate 之間嘅 trade-off。
  • ExamROC curve plots True positive rate TPR (on the \( y \)-axis) against False positive rate FPR (on the \( x \)-axis)。
  • 一個 model 嘅 performance 係 ROC 上嘅一個點；改變 classifier 嘅 threshold 會改變點嘅位置。
⭐ 考試重點：ROC 特殊點 (Slide 33)，坐標寫法 (TPR, FPR)
(TPR, FPR)意思
(0, 0)Declare everything to be negative class
(1, 1)Declare everything to be positive class
(1, 0)Ideal（\( TPR = 1 \)、\( FPR = 0 \)；圖上係左上角）
Diagonal lineRandom guessing
Below diagonal linePrediction is opposite of the true class（將預測反轉就會變好）
⚠️ 易混淆

Slide 33 用 (TPR, FPR) 次序寫坐標，所以 ideal 係 (1, 0)；但圖上 \( x \) 軸係 FPR、\( y \) 軸係 TPR，即圖上坐標 \( (FPR, TPR) = (0, 1) \) 左上角。考試寫清楚你用邊個次序。

9.1 Continuous-valued outputs (Slides 34–36)

要畫 ROC curve，classifier 必須產生 continuous-valued output（score），用嚟將 test records 由「最可能係 positive」排到「最唔可能」。好多 classifiers 只產生 discrete output（predicted class），但可以攞到 continuous outputs：Decision trees（leaf 入面 positive 比例）、rule-based classifiers、neural networks、Bayesian classifiers（posterior probability）、k-nearest neighbors（neighbors 中 positive 比例）、SVM（距離 hyperplane \(\mathbf{w}\cdot\mathbf{x}+b\)）。

Slide 35：Decision tree 嘅 continuous-valued outputs（每個 leaf 嘅 class 比例）。Slide 36：一維 data 有兩個 classes，\( x > t \) 就分類為 positive；喺某個 threshold \( t \)：\( TPR = 0.5 \)、\( FNR = 0.5 \)、\( FPR = 0.12 \)、\( TNR = 0.88 \)。\( t \) 向左移 → TPR 同 FPR 一齊上升。

🖼️ 圖片內容

Slides 33、35–37、39 嘅 ROC 圖、decision tree 圖同 slide 39 嘅 score 表係圖片；以下 worked example 為自擬數字。

9.2 How to Construct an ROC Curve (Slides 38–39)

⭐ 考試重點：構建步驟
  1. Use a classifier that produces a continuous-valued score for each instance（越可能係 + class，score 越高）。
  2. Sort the instances in decreasing order according to the score。
  3. Apply a threshold at each unique value of the score（\( \text{score} \ge \text{threshold} \) → 預測 +）。
  4. Count the number of TP, FP, TN, FN at each threshold。
  5. \( TPR = TP/(TP + FN) \)；\( FPR = FP/(FP + TN) \)；將每對 \( (FPR, TPR) \) 畫出並連線。

Worked example（自擬）：10 個 instances（5 個 +、5 個 −）：

ScoreClassThreshold \( \ge \)TPFPFNTNTPRFPR
0.95+0.9510450.20
0.90+0.9020350.40
0.85−0.8521340.40.2
0.80+0.8031240.60.2
0.70−0.7032230.60.4
0.60+0.6042130.80.4
0.50−0.5043120.80.6
0.40−0.4044110.80.8
0.30+0.3054011.00.8
0.20−0.2055001.01.0

加上起點 \( (FPR, TPR) = (0, 0) \)（\( \text{threshold} > 0.95 \)，全部預測 −）。連線：(0,0)→(0,0.2)→(0,0.4)→(0.2,0.4)→(0.2,0.6)→(0.4,0.6)→(0.4,0.8)→(0.6,0.8)→(0.8,0.8)→(0.8,1)→(1,1)。

AUC（梯形 / 長方形面積）：FPR 0–0.2 段 \( TPR = 0.4 \) → 0.08；0.2–0.4 段 \( TPR = 0.6 \) → 0.12；0.4–0.6 段 0.8 → 0.16；0.6–0.8 段 0.8 → 0.16；0.8–1 段 1.0 → 0.2。總和 = 0.72。

💡 快速畫法

由 (0,0) 開始，按 score 由高到低逐個睇：遇到 + 就向上行 \( 1/P \)（\( P \) = positive 總數），遇到 − 就向右行 \( 1/N \)。Score 有 ties 時就斜行。AUC 亦等於「隨機揀一個 + 同一個 −，+ 嘅 score 高過 − 嘅概率」：呢度 25 對之中有 18 對 + 較高 → 18/25 = 0.72。

9.3 Using ROC for Model Comparison (Slide 37)

  • No model consistently outperform the other（兩條 ROC 交叉時）：M1 is better for small FPR，M2 is better for large FPR。揀邊個視乎應用可接受幾多 false alarms。
  • Area Under the ROC curve (AUC)：Ideal: Area = 1；Random guess: Area = 0.5。
from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, roc_auc_score
y = [1,1,0,1,0,1,0,0,1,0]; s = [.95,.90,.85,.80,.70,.60,.50,.40,.30,.20]
fpr, tpr, thr = roc_curve(y, s)
roc_auc_score(y, s)   # 0.72

10. Class Imbalance Problem

Slide 41：好多 classification problems 嘅 classes 係 skewed（一個 class 嘅 records 遠多過另一個）：

  • Credit card fraud
  • Intrusion detection
  • Defective products in manufacturing assembly line

Evaluation measures such as accuracy is not well-suited for imbalanced class. 偵測 rare class 就好似 "finding needle in a haystack"。Slides 42–50 嘅 confusion matrix 同 alternative measures 已喺上面 §5、§7 詳述。

10.1 Handling Class Imbalanced Problem (Slide 51)

⭐ 考試重點：三大方法
  1. Class-based ordering：Rules for rare class have higher priority（rule-based classifier 先檢查 rare class 嘅 rules）。
  2. Cost-sensitive classification：Misclassifying rare class as majority class is more expensive than misclassifying majority as rare class。
  3. Sampling-based approaches（slide 57）：Modify the distribution of training data so that rare class is well-represented：Under-sample the majority class、Over-sample the rare class。

10.2 Cost-Sensitive Classification (Slides 54–56)

Example：Bayesian classifier。給定 test record \( x \)：計每個 class \( i \) 嘅 \(p(i \mid x)\)；decision rule：classify as class \( k \) if \(k = \arg\max_i p(i \mid x)\)。2-class 時：classify \( x \) as + if \(p(+|x) \gt p(-|x)\)。

呢條 rule implicitly assumes \( C(+|+) = C(-|-) = 0 \) and \( C(+|-) = C(-|+) \)（即正確冇 cost、兩種錯誤 cost 一樣）。

General decision rule：classify test record \( x \) as class \( k \) if \( k = \arg\min_j \sum_i p(i \mid x)\, C(i, j) \)（揀 expected cost 最低嘅 class）。2-class：

$$ \text{Cost}(+) = p(+|x)\,C(+,+) + p(-|x)\,C(-,+) $$
$$ \text{Cost}(-) = p(+|x)\,C(+,-) + p(-|x)\,C(-,-) $$

Decision rule：classify \( x \) as + if \( \text{Cost}(+) < \text{Cost}(-) \)。如果 \( C(+,+) = C(-,-) = 0 \)：

$$ \text{classify as + if } \; p(+|x) \gt \frac{C(-,+)}{C(-,+) + C(+,-)} $$

（\( C(i, j) \) = 實際 class \( i \) 被預測為 \( j \) 嘅 cost。）

🖼️ 圖片內容

Slides 54–55 嘅 argmax / argmin 公式同最後 threshold 公式係圖片；上面係按 slide 文字 \( \text{Cost}(+) \)、\( \text{Cost}(-) \) 推導出嘅標準結果，請對照原 slide。

⭐ 考試重點：Slide 56 Sick / Healthy 例子

Given：\( p(\text{sick} \mid x) = 0.3 \)，\( p(\text{healthy} \mid x) = 0.7 \)；\( C(\text{predict healthy} \mid \text{actually sick}) = 100{,}000 \)（missed diagnosis）；\( C(\text{predict sick} \mid \text{actually healthy}) = 1{,}000 \)（false alarm）。

Standard Bayes decision：0.3 < 0.7 ⟹ Predict "healthy"。

Cost-sensitive decision：

  • Expected cost of predicting sick \( = p(\text{healthy} \mid x) \times 1{,}000 = 0.7 \times 1{,}000 = \) 700
  • Expected cost of predicting healthy \( = p(\text{sick} \mid x) \times 100{,}000 = 0.3 \times 100{,}000 = \) 30,000

700 < 30,000 ⟹ Predict "sick" ✓

用 threshold 公式：predict sick if \( p(\text{sick} \mid x) > 1{,}000/(1{,}000 + 100{,}000) = \) 0.0099。0.3 > 0.0099 → sick。

10.3 Sampling-based Approaches (Slide 57)

方法做法風險
Under-sample the majority class隨機抽走部分 majority records，令兩類數目接近丟失有用資訊
Over-sample the rare class重複（或合成，例如 SMOTE）rare class records重複 records 可能導致 overfitting
⚠️ 常見錯誤

Sampling 只可以做喺 training set；test set 要保持原本 distribution，否則評估結果唔反映現實。亦要先 split 再 over-sample，避免同一 record 嘅 copy 同時出現喺 train 同 test。

from sklearn.utils import resample
minority = train[train.y == 1]; majority = train[train.y == 0]
up = resample(minority, replace=True, n_samples=len(majority), random_state=0)    # over-sample
down = resample(majority, replace=False, n_samples=len(minority), random_state=0) # under-sample
# 或 cost-sensitive：DecisionTreeClassifier(class_weight={0: 1, 1: 100})

自我測驗 Self-test

Q1. 一個 model training error 2%、test error 25%；另一個 training error 20%、test error 22%。各屬咩情況？

第一個：training error 細但 test error 大 → Overfitting（model 太複雜）。第二個：兩者都大 → 傾向 Underfitting（model 太簡單）。可以用 validation set 揀中間複雜度、增加 training data，或 pruning。

Q2. Confusion matrix：\( TP = 30, FN = 20, FP = 10, TN = 940 \)。計 Accuracy、Precision、Recall、F、FPR、Specificity。

\( \text{Total} = 1000 \)。\( \text{Accuracy} = 970/1000 = \) 0.97；\( \text{Precision} = 30/40 = \) 0.75；\( \text{Recall} = 30/50 = \) 0.6；\( F = 2(0.75)(0.6)/1.35 = \) 0.667（或 \( 2a/(2a+b+c) = 60/90 \)）；\( FPR = 10/950 = \) 0.0105；\( \text{Specificity} = 940/950 = \) 0.989。

Q3. Cost matrix \( C(+,+)=0, C(+,-)=50, C(-,+)=5, C(-,-)=0 \)。Model A：TP 80, FN 20, FP 100, TN 800；Model B：TP 95, FN 5, FP 300, TN 600。邊個 accuracy 高？邊個 cost 低？

A：\( \text{accuracy} = 880/1000 = 0.88 \)；\( \text{cost} = 20 \times 50 + 100 \times 5 = 1000 + 500 = \) 1500。
B：\( \text{accuracy} = 695/1000 = 0.695 \)；\( \text{cost} = 5 \times 50 + 300 \times 5 = 250 + 1500 = \) 1750。
A accuracy 較高而 cost 亦較低 → A 較好。（如果 \( C(+,-) \) 改做 100：\( A = 2500 \)，\( B = 2000 \)，就會變成 B 較平。）

Q4. 解釋 holdout、k-fold CV、leave-one-out 同 stratified CV。數據得 200 records 而 positive 只有 10 個，應用邊個？

Holdout：2/3 train、1/3 test。k-fold：分 \( k \) 份，輪流用 1 份 test、\( k - 1 \) 份 train。LOOCV：\( k = n \)。Stratified：確保每份 class 比例相同。細樣本 + imbalanced → 用 stratified (repeated) k-fold CV，否則某啲 folds 可能冇 positive。

Q5. ROC 上 \( (FPR, TPR) = (0, 0) \)、(1, 1)、(0, 1) 同對角線各代表咩？\( AUC = 0.5 \) 代表咩？

(0,0)：全部預測 negative；(1,1)：全部預測 positive；(0,1)：ideal（slide 用 (TPR, FPR) 寫成 (1,0)）；對角線：random guessing。\( AUC = 0.5 \) = random guess；\( AUC = 1 \) = ideal。

Q6. Scores 同 labels：0.9(+), 0.8(−), 0.7(+), 0.6(+), 0.4(−), 0.3(−)。畫 ROC 嘅點並計 AUC。

\( P = 3, N = 3 \)。Threshold \( \ge 0.9 \)：TP1 FP0 → (0, 0.333)；\( \ge 0.8 \)：(0.333, 0.333)；\( \ge 0.7 \)：(0.333, 0.667)；\( \ge 0.6 \)：(0.333, 1)；\( \ge 0.4 \)：(0.667, 1)；\( \ge 0.3 \)：(1, 1)。加 (0,0)。\( AUC = 0.333 \times 0.333 + 0.667 \times 1 = 0.111 + 0.667 = \) 0.778（= 9 對中 7 對 + 較高 = 7/9）。

Q7. \( p(\text{fraud} \mid x) = 0.05 \)。漏報 fraud 嘅 cost = 2000，誤報 cost = 50，正確冇 cost。應該預測咩？

\( \text{Cost}(\text{predict fraud}) = p(\text{normal} \mid x) \times 50 = 0.95 \times 50 = 47.5 \)；\( \text{Cost}(\text{predict normal}) = p(\text{fraud} \mid x) \times 2000 = 0.05 \times 2000 = 100 \)。47.5 < 100 → predict fraud。\( \text{Threshold} = 50/(50 + 2000) = 0.0244 < 0.05 \)。

Q8. 點解 precision 會受 class imbalance 影響，但 TPR / FPR 唔會？用 slide 47 例子解釋。

TPR 只用實際 positive 嗰行（\( TP/(TP+FN) \)），FPR 只用實際 negative 嗰行（\( FP/(FP+TN) \)），各自係行內比例，唔受兩類相對數目影響。\( \text{Precision} = TP/(TP+FP) \) 混合咗兩行：negative 多 100 倍時 FP 亦多 100 倍（10 → 1000），precision 由 0.8 跌到 0.038，雖然 \( TPR = 0.8 \)、\( FPR = 0.2 \) 冇變。

Q9. Validation set 同 test set 有咩分別？點解唔可以用 test set 揀 hyperparameters？

Validation set 由 training data 分出，用嚟估 generalization error、tune complexity / hyperparameters、model selection；test set 只喺最後評估一次。用 test set 揀 hyperparameters 會令 test set 間接參與 training，報告嘅 performance 過度樂觀，唔再係 unseen data 嘅公正估計。

一頁總結 Cheat sheet

⭐ 考前速記
  • Errors：training (apparent)、test、generalization (expected error on same distribution)。
  • Underfitting：太簡單，train & test error 都大；Overfitting：太複雜，train error 細 test error 大。更多 training data → 減少 train/test 差距。
  • Model selection：validation set（≠ test set；缺點：少咗 training data）、model complexity（Occam's Razor）、statistical bounds。
  • Confusion matrix：\( a = TP \)、\( b = FN \)、\( c = FP \)、\( d = TN \)（行 = actual，列 = predicted）。
  • \( \text{Accuracy} = (a+d)/N \)；\( \text{Precision} = a/(a+c) \)；\( \text{Recall} = TPR = a/(a+b) \)；\( F = 2rp/(r+p) = 2a/(2a+b+c) \)；\( TNR = d/(c+d) \)；\( FPR = c/(c+d) = \alpha \) (Type I)；\( FNR = b/(a+b) = \beta \) (Type II)。
  • Accuracy misleading：9990 vs 10，全估 0 → 99.9%。Precision 受 imbalance 影響，TPR / FPR 唔受。
  • Cost \( = \sum \text{count} \times \text{cost} \)；M1 (80%, 3910) 好過 M2 (90%, 4255)。Precision 偏向 \( C(\text{Y} \mid \text{Y}) \)、\( C(\text{Y} \mid \text{N}) \)；Recall 偏向 \( C(\text{Y} \mid \text{Y}) \)、\( C(\text{N} \mid \text{Y}) \)；F 除 \( C(\text{N} \mid \text{N}) \) 外全部。
  • Evaluation：holdout (2/3 : 1/3)、random subsampling (repeated holdout)、k-fold CV、LOOCV (\( k = n \))、repeated CV（估 variance）、stratified CV（imbalanced + 細樣本）。
  • ROC：\( y = TPR \)、\( x = FPR \)；\( (TPR,FPR)=(0,0) \) 全 −、(1,1) 全 +、(1,0) ideal；diagonal random；below = 反轉。要 continuous scores；sort desc → 每個 unique score 做 threshold → 計 TPR/FPR。AUC：1 ideal、0.5 random；曲線交叉時 M1 好喺細 FPR、M2 好喺大 FPR。
  • Imbalance handling：class-based ordering、cost-sensitive (predict + if \( p(+|x) > C(-,+)/(C(-,+)+C(+,-)) \))、sampling (under-sample majority / over-sample rare)。
  • Sick 例：0.7×1000 = 700 < 0.3×100000 = 30000 → predict sick。

title: Cluster Analysis: K-means, Hierarchical & DBSCAN
meta: COM6004 · Chapter 5 · Source: COM6004_Chapter_5_Cluster_Analysis.pptx (94 slides) · Cluster Analysis, K-means, Hierarchical Clustering, Cluster Validity, DBSCAN (optional)
html:
🎯 本講重點 (Learning outcomes)

  • 定義 cluster analysis；分辨 partitional vs hierarchical clusterings，以及 exclusive / fuzzy / partial / heterogeneous 等 distinctions。
  • 認識四種 cluster types：well-separated、center-based、contiguity-based、density-based。
  • 識手計 K-means（assign → update centroid → repeat）同 SSE；理解 initial centroids 問題、K-means++、K-means 嘅 limitations 同 pre/post-processing。
  • 識手做 agglomerative hierarchical clustering（MIN / MAX / Group Average），畫 dendrogram，理解各自優缺點同 time / space complexity。
  • 用 internal measures 評估 clusters：correlation、similarity matrix、SSE（elbow）、cohesion & separation（SSE / SSB）、Silhouette coefficient。
  • DBSCAN（optional）：core / border / noise points、algorithm、優缺點、點揀 Eps 同 MinPts。

⭐ 考試必溫 Top-5

  1. K-means 手計 iterations + \( SSE = \sum_i \sum_{x\in C_i} \text{dist}^2(m_i, x) \)。
  2. Agglomerative clustering 用 MIN / MAX / Group Average 更新 proximity matrix 同畫 dendrogram。
  3. Silhouette coefficient \( s = (b - a)/\max(a, b) \) 計算同解讀。
  4. K-means limitations（differing sizes、densities、non-globular shapes、outliers）同 initial centroids 問題（\( P = K!/K^K \)，\( K = 10 \) 時 0.00036）、K-means++。
  5. MIN（處理 non-elliptical shapes，但對 noise 敏感）vs MAX（較唔受 noise 影響，但會打散大 cluster、偏向 globular）vs Group Average（折衷）。

1. What is Cluster Analysis?

ExamSlide 4：Finding groups of objects such that the objects in a group will be similar (or related) to one another and different from (or unrelated to) the objects in other groups.

  • Intra-cluster distances are minimized
  • Inter-cluster distances are maximized

Applications (slide 5)：

  • Understanding：Group related documents for browsing、group genes and proteins that have similar functionality、group stocks with similar price fluctuations。
  • Summarization：Reduce the size of large data sets（例：Clustering precipitation in Australia）。

Notion of a Cluster can be Ambiguous (slide 6)：同一組點可以睇成 Two Clusters、Four Clusters 或 Six Clusters——"How many clusters?" 冇唯一答案，視乎 granularity 同應用。

🔗 跨科連繫

Clustering 係 unsupervised（冇 class label），Chapter 4 Classification 係 supervised。Chapter 1 已介紹 market segmentation、document clustering；Chapter 2 嘅 distance / similarity measures 係 clustering 嘅基礎；Chapter 2 discretization 亦可用 K-means 搵 breaks。

2. Types of Clusterings

Slide 7：A clustering is a set of clusters。重要區分：

Partitional ClusteringHierarchical Clustering
定義A division of data objects into non-overlapping subsets (clusters) such that each data object is in exactly one subsetA set of nested clusters organized as a hierarchical tree
表示 (slides 8–9)平面上一組分開嘅 groupsDendrogram（traditional：binary tree；non-traditional：一個 node 可有多個 children）
例子演算法K-means、DBSCANAgglomerative（MIN、MAX、Group Average）、Divisive
🖼️ 圖片內容

Slides 8–9 嘅 partitional clustering 圖同 traditional / non-traditional hierarchical clustering 及 dendrograms 係圖片，請對照原 slide。

2.1 Other Distinctions Between Sets of Clusters (Slide 10)

Distinction說明
Exclusive vs non-exclusiveNon-exclusive clusterings：points may belong to multiple clusters（可以代表 multiple classes 或 'border' points）。
Fuzzy vs non-fuzzyFuzzy clustering：一個 point 以 0 至 1 嘅 weight 屬於每個 cluster；weights must sum to 1。Probabilistic clustering 有類似特性。
Partial vs complete有時只想 cluster 部分 data（例如唔理 noise）。
Heterogeneous vs homogeneousClusters 嘅 sizes、shapes、densities 可以差好遠。

3. Types of Clusters

⭐ 考試重點：四種 cluster 定義 (Slides 11–15)
TypeSlide 定義Slide 圖例
Well-separatedA cluster is a set of points such that any point in a cluster is closer (or more similar) to every other point in the cluster than to any point not in the cluster.3 well-separated clusters
Center-basedAn object in a cluster is closer to the "center" of a cluster than to the center of any other cluster. Center 通常係 centroid（cluster 所有點嘅平均）或 medoid（最 "representative" 嘅實際點）。4 center-based clusters
Contiguity-based（Nearest neighbor / Transitive）A point in a cluster is closer to one or more other points in the cluster than to any point not in the cluster.8 contiguous clusters
Density-basedA cluster is a dense region of points, separated by low-density regions from other regions of high density. Used when the clusters are irregular or intertwined, and when noise and outliers are present.6 density-based clusters
💡 直覺理解

Well-separated 最嚴格（要比所有外面點近過所有內部點）。Center-based 係 K-means 嘅假設（圓形 / globular clusters）。Contiguity 好似「手拉手」嘅鏈條——只要同鄰居近就算同組（MIN / single link 嘅 idea）。Density-based 係 DBSCAN 嘅 idea：密集區就係 cluster，稀疏區係分界或者 noise。

3.1 Characteristics of the Input Data Are Important (Slide 16)

  • Type of proximity or density measure：central to clustering，視乎 data 同 application。
  • 影響 proximity / density 嘅 data characteristics：Dimensionality、Sparseness（curse of dimensionality）、Attribute type、Special relationships in the data（例如 autocorrelation）、Distribution of the data。
  • Noise and Outliers：often interfere with the operation of the clustering algorithm。

Slide 17：本 chapter 主要講 K-means clustering 同 Hierarchical clustering（另附 DBSCAN optional）。

4. K-means Clustering

Slide 19：

  • Partitional clustering approach
  • Number of clusters, K, must be specified
  • Each cluster is associated with a centroid (center point)
  • Each point is assigned to the cluster with the closest centroid
  • The basic algorithm is very simple：
⭐ 考試重點：Basic K-means Algorithm 
1: Select K points as the initial centroids.
2: repeat
3:     Form K clusters by assigning all points to the closest centroid.
4:     Recompute the centroid of each cluster.
5: until The centroids don't change
🖼️ 圖片內容

Slide 19 嘅 algorithm 框同 slides 20–21 嘅 K-means iteration 動畫圖係圖片；上面 algorithm 係教科書標準版本，請對照原 slide。

4.1 K-means Details (Slide 22)

  • Initial centroids are often chosen randomly → clusters produced vary from one run to another。
  • Centroid is (typically) the mean of the points in the cluster。
  • 'Closeness' is measured by Euclidean distance, cosine similarity, correlation, etc.
  • K-means will converge for common similarity measures mentioned above。
  • Most of the convergence happens in the first few iterations；stopping condition 常改為 'Until relatively few points change clusters'。
  • ExamComplexity is \( O(n \times K \times I \times d) \)：n = number of points，K = number of clusters，I = number of iterations，d = number of attributes。

4.2 Worked example：1-D K-means（自擬）

⭐ 考試重點：手計 K-means

Points：2, 3, 4, 10, 11, 12, 20, 25, 30；\( K = 2 \)；initial centroids \(c_1 = 2\)，\(c_2 = 12\)。

Iteration 1：assign 去最近 centroid：

  • \(C_1\) (\( c = 2 \))：{2, 3, 4}（例如 4：|4−2| = 2 < |4−12| = 8）
  • \(C_2\) (\( c = 12 \))：{10, 11, 12, 20, 25, 30}（例如 10：|10−2| = 8 > |10−12| = 2）
  • Update：\( c_1 = (2+3+4)/3 = \) 3；\( c_2 = (10+11+12+20+25+30)/6 = 108/6 = \) 18

Iteration 2（\(c_1 = 3\), \(c_2 = 18\)）：

  • 10：|10−3| = 7 < |10−18| = 8 → \(C_1\)；11：8 > 7 → \(C_2\)
  • \( C_1 = \{2, 3, 4, 10\} \)；\( C_2 = \{11, 12, 20, 25, 30\} \)
  • Update：\( c_1 = 19/4 = \) 4.75；\( c_2 = 98/5 = \) 19.6

Iteration 3（\(c_1 = 4.75\), \(c_2 = 19.6\)）：

  • 11：|11−4.75| = 6.25 < 8.6 → \(C_1\)；12：7.25 < 7.6 → \(C_1\)
  • \( C_1 = \{2, 3, 4, 10, 11, 12\} \)；\( C_2 = \{20, 25, 30\} \)
  • Update：\( c_1 = 42/6 = \) 7；\( c_2 = 75/3 = \) 25

Iteration 4（\(c_1 = 7\), \(c_2 = 25\)）：assignment 冇變 → centroids 冇變 → converged。

SSE = \( C_1 \)：\( (2-7)^2 + (3-7)^2 + (4-7)^2 + (10-7)^2 + (11-7)^2 + (12-7)^2 = 25+16+9+9+16+25 = 100 \)；\( C_2 \)：\( (20-25)^2 + 0 + (30-25)^2 = 50 \) → \( SSE = 150 \)。

每次 iteration 嘅 SSE（用 update 後 centroid 計）：348 → 307.95 → 150，單調下降。

from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

km = KMeans(n_clusters=2, init=np.array([[2], [12]]), n_init=1).fit(X)

4.3 Evaluating K-means Clusters: SSE (Slide 23)

Most common measure is Sum of Squared Error (SSE)：每個 point 嘅 error = 佢同最近 cluster（centroid）嘅距離；將 errors 平方再加總：

$$ SSE = \sum_{i=1}^{K} \sum_{x \in C_i} \text{dist}^2(m_i, x) $$

\(x\) 係 cluster \(C_i\) 入面嘅 data point，\(m_i\) 係 cluster \(C_i\) 嘅 representative point。可以證明令 SSE 最細嘅 \(m_i\) 就係 cluster 嘅 center (mean)。

  • Given two sets of clusters, we prefer the one with the smallest error。
  • ExamOne easy way to reduce SSE is to increase K（\( K = n \) 時 \( SSE = 0 \)！所以唔可以單靠 SSE 揀 K）。
  • A good clustering with smaller K can have a lower SSE than a poor clustering with higher K。

Slide 24 "Two different K-means Clusterings"：同一組 original points，可以得到 Optimal Clustering 或 Sub-optimal Clustering——取決於 initial centroids。

4.4 Importance of Choosing Initial Centroids (Slides 25–31)

Slides 25–26 圖示：好嘅 initial centroids 幾個 iterations 就搵到 optimal；差嘅 initial centroids 會卡喺 sub-optimal（local minimum）。

ExamSlide 27：如果有 K 個 'real' clusters，揀到每個 cluster 各一個 initial centroid 嘅機會好細，K 越大越細。如果每個 cluster 大小都係 n：

$$ P = \frac{\text{number of ways to select one centroid from each cluster}}{\text{number of ways to select } K \text{ centroids}} = \frac{K!\,n^K}{(Kn)^K} = \frac{K!}{K^K} $$

例如 \( K = 10 \)：\( P = 10!/10^{10} = 3{,}628{,}800 / 10{,}000{,}000{,}000 = \) 0.00036。（\( K = 3 \)：3!/27 = 0.222；\( K = 5 \)：120/3125 = 0.0384。）

有時 initial centroids 會自己 readjust 去「正確」位置，有時唔會。Five pairs of clusters 例子（10 clusters，slides 28–31）：

  • Slides 28–29：Starting with two initial centroids in one cluster of each pair of clusters → 每對 clusters 有兩個 centroids，結果可以正確分開。
  • Slides 30–31：Starting with some pairs of clusters having three initial centroids, while others have only one → 有一個 centroid 嘅嗰對 clusters 會被合併成一個，有三個 centroids 嘅會將一個 cluster 錯誤切開。

4.5 Solutions to Initial Centroids Problem (Slide 32)

  • Multiple runs：有幫助，但 probability is not on your side（K 大時要好多次）；揀 SSE 最細嗰次。
  • Sample and use hierarchical clustering to determine initial centroids。
  • Generate a larger number of clusters and then perform a hierarchical clustering（merging the clusters）。
  • Select more than k initial centroids and then select among these initial centroids（e.g., select most widely separated）。
  • Use some strategy to select the k initial centroids：K-means++ is a robust way of doing this selection。

4.6 K-means++ (Slide 33)

比 random initialization 慢，但 very consistently produces better results in terms of SSE；保證 approximation ratio \( O(\log k) \) in expectation。

⭐ 考試重點：K-means++ 步驟
  1. Select an initial point at random to be the first centroid。
  2. For \( k - 1 \) steps：
    • For each of the N points \(x_i\)，搵佢同目前已選 centroids \(C_1, \dots, C_j\) 嘅 minimum squared distance：\( d(x_i) = \min_j \|x_i - C_j\|^2 \)。
    • Randomly select a new centroid by choosing a point with probability proportional to \( d(x_i) / \sum_i d(x_i) \)。
  3. End For
💡 Worked example（自擬）

Points：0, 1, 5, 6, 10。第一個 centroid 隨機揀咗 0。

Squared distance to nearest centroid：0, 1, 25, 36, 100 → 總和 162。

揀第二個 centroid 嘅概率：0 → 0；1 → 1/162 = 0.006；5 → 25/162 = 0.154；6 → 36/162 = 0.222；10 → 100/162 = 0.617。

即係越遠嘅點越大機會被揀，令 centroids 自然分散，但仍有隨機性（唔會一定揀 outlier）。

4.7 Limitations of K-means (Slides 34–40)

⭐ 考試重點：K-means limitations

K-means has problems when clusters are of differing：

  • Sizes（slide 35：大 cluster 被切開，部分分去細 cluster）
  • Densities（slide 36：密嘅細 clusters 同疏嘅大 cluster 被錯誤劃分）
  • Non-globular shapes（slide 37：例如兩個半月形 / 環形，K-means 只會切成兩半圓）

K-means has problems when the data contains outliers（mean 被拉走；SSE 用平方，outlier 影響更大）。One possible solution is to remove outliers before clustering。

Overcoming K-means Limitations (slides 38–40)：One solution is to find a large number of clusters such that each of them represents a part of a natural cluster. But these small clusters need to be put together in a post-processing step.

💡 直覺理解

K-means 用 centroid + Euclidean distance，等於假設每個 cluster 係「大小相若嘅圓球」，而 cluster 之間嘅分界係兩個 centroids 嘅垂直平分線。任何違反呢個假設嘅情況（大細唔同、密度唔同、形狀唔係圓）都會出錯。

4.8 Pre-processing and Post-processing (Slide 41)

Pre-processingPost-processing
  • Normalize the data（attributes scale 唔同會令 distance 偏向某 attribute）
  • Eliminate outliers
  • Eliminate small clusters that may represent outliers
  • Split 'loose' clusters, i.e., clusters with relatively high SSE
  • Merge clusters that are 'close' and that have relatively low SSE

5. Hierarchical Clustering

Slide 43：Produces a set of nested clusters organized as a hierarchical tree；can be visualized as a dendrogram——a tree like diagram that records the sequences of merges or splits（y 軸係 merge 時嘅距離）。

Strengths (slide 44)：

  • Do not have to assume any particular number of clusters：any desired number of clusters can be obtained by 'cutting' the dendrogram at the proper level。
  • They may correspond to meaningful taxonomies：例如 biological sciences 嘅 animal kingdom（slide notes：Vertebrates → Mammals（Primates、Rodents、Carnivores）、Birds、Reptiles、Fish；Invertebrates → Arthropods、Mollusks、Annelids）。

5.1 Agglomerative vs Divisive (Slide 45)

Agglomerative（bottom-up）Divisive（top-down）
Start with the points as individual clusters；at each step, merge the closest pair of clusters until only one cluster (or k clusters) left Start with one, all-inclusive cluster；at each step, split a cluster until each cluster contains an individual point (or there are k clusters)

Traditional hierarchical algorithms use a similarity or distance matrix，merge or split one cluster at a time。

5.2 Agglomerative Clustering Algorithm (Slides 46–50)

⭐ 考試重點：Algorithm 
1. Compute the proximity matrix
2. Let each data point be a cluster
3. Repeat
4.     Merge the two closest clusters
5.     Update the proximity matrix
6. Until only a single cluster remains

Key operation is the computation of the proximity of two clusters：different approaches to defining the distance between clusters distinguish the different algorithms。

Slides 47–50：Starting situation（每點一個 cluster + proximity matrix）→ intermediate situation（clusters C1…C5）→ 要 merge 最近嘅 C2 同 C5 → merge 後問題："How do we update the proximity matrix?"（C2 ∪ C5 嗰行 / 列要重新計）。

5.3 How to Define Inter-Cluster Distance (Slides 51–55)

⭐ 考試重點：四種定義
方法定義公式
MIN (Single Link)兩個 clusters 中最近嗰對點嘅距離（determined by one pair of points, i.e., by one link in the proximity graph）\( d(C_i, C_j) = \min_{p \in C_i, q \in C_j} d(p, q) \)
MAX (Complete Linkage)兩個 clusters 中最遠嗰對點嘅距離（determined by all pairs of points）\( d(C_i, C_j) = \max_{p \in C_i, q \in C_j} d(p, q) \)
Group Average兩 clusters 之間所有 pairwise proximity 嘅平均\( d(C_i, C_j) = \dfrac{\sum_{p \in C_i}\sum_{q \in C_j} d(p, q)}{|C_i| \times |C_j|} \)
Distance Between Centroids兩個 centroids 之間嘅距離\( d(C_i, C_j) = d(m_i, m_j) \)

5.5 MIN (Single Link): Strength & Limitations (Slides 56–59)

  • Strength：Can handle non-elliptical shapes（slide 58：six clusters，可以沿住鏈狀 / 彎曲形狀連埋一齊）。
  • Limitation：Sensitive to noise（slide 59：noise points 可以喺兩個 clusters 之間「搭橋」，令佢哋被 chain 埋一齊——chaining effect）。

5.6 MAX (Complete Linkage): Strength & Limitations (Slides 60–63)

  • Strength：Less susceptible to noise（slide 62）。
  • Limitations：Tends to break large clusters；Biased towards globular clusters（slide 63）。

5.7 Group Average (Slides 64–66)

  • Proximity of two clusters is the average of pairwise proximity between points in the two clusters。
  • Need to use average connectivity for scalability since total proximity favors large clusters（所以要除以 \(|C_i| \times |C_j|\)）。
  • Compromise between Single and Complete Link。
  • Strengths：Less susceptible to noise and outliers。Limitations：Biased towards globular clusters。
⭐ 考試重點：比較表
LinkageStrengthLimitation
MIN (single)Non-elliptical shapesSensitive to noise & outliers (chaining)
MAX (complete)Less susceptible to noiseBreaks large clusters；biased towards globular
Group AverageLess susceptible to noise & outliers（折衷）Biased towards globular

5.8 Time and Space Requirements (Slide 67)

  • \(O(N^2)\) space since it uses the proximity matrix（N = number of points）。
  • \(O(N^3)\) time in many cases：there are N steps and at each step the size \(N^2\) proximity matrix must be updated and searched。
  • Complexity can be reduced to \(O(N^2 \log(N))\) time with some cleverness。

對比 K-means 嘅 \(O(n\cdot K\cdot I\cdot d)\)，hierarchical clustering 對大 data sets 慢好多。

5.9 Problems and Limitations (Slide 68)

  • Once a decision is made to combine two clusters, it cannot be undone（greedy）。
  • No global objective function is directly minimized（唔似 K-means minimize SSE）。
  • Different schemes have problems with one or more of：sensitivity to noise and outliers；difficulty handling clusters of different sizes and non-globular shapes；breaking large clusters。

6. Cluster Validity

Slide 70：Supervised classification 有 accuracy、precision、recall 等 measures。Cluster analysis 嘅對應問題係：點樣評估 clusters 嘅 "goodness"？但 "clusters are in the eye of the beholder"! 咁點解仲要評估？

  • To avoid finding patterns in noise（K-means 喺 random data 上都會「搵到」K 個 clusters！）
  • To compare clustering algorithms
  • To compare two sets of clusters
  • To compare two clusters

6.1 Different Aspects of Cluster Validation (Slide 71)

  1. Determining the clustering tendency of a set of data, i.e., distinguishing whether non-random structure actually exists in the data。
  2. Comparing the results of a cluster analysis to externally known results, e.g., to externally given class labels（external index）。
  3. Evaluating how well the results of a cluster analysis fit the data without reference to external information（use only the data → internal index）。
  4. Comparing the results of two different sets of cluster analyses to determine which is better。
  5. Determining the 'correct' number of clusters。

For 2, 3, and 4, we can further distinguish whether we want to evaluate the entire clustering or just individual clusters。

6.2 Measures of Cluster Validity Via Correlation (Slides 72–73)

兩個 matrices：

  • Proximity Matrix
  • Ideal Similarity Matrix：每個 data point 一行一列；entry = 1 if the pair belongs to the same cluster，0 if different clusters。

計兩個 matrices 嘅 correlation。因為 matrices 係 symmetric，只需要計 \( n(n-1)/2 \) 個 entries。High correlation 表示同一 cluster 嘅點互相接近。Not a good measure for some density or contiguity-based clusters.

⚠️ 留意符號

如果用 distance matrix（而唔係 similarity），好 clustering 嘅 correlation 會係負數（同 cluster → ideal = 1 而 distance 細）。教科書例子（slide 73）兩個 data sets 嘅 correlation 分別約 −0.92（清晰 clusters）同 −0.58（random data）——數字以 slide 圖為準。

6.3 Using Similarity Matrix for Cluster Validation (Slides 74–76)

Order the similarity matrix with respect to cluster labels and inspect visually. 好嘅 clustering 會見到對角線上有清晰嘅高相似度方塊。Clusters in random data are not so crisp（slides 75–76：DBSCAN、K-means、Complete Link 喺 random data 上嘅方塊都模糊）。

6.4 Internal Measures: SSE (Slides 77–78)

Internal Index：used to measure the goodness of a clustering structure without respect to external information，例如 SSE。

  • SSE is good for comparing two clusterings or two clusters（average SSE）。
  • Can also be used to estimate the number of clusters：畫 SSE vs K 曲線，搵 "knee / elbow"（SSE 急跌之後變平嘅位置）。
  • Clusters in more complicated figures aren't well separated（slide 78：SSE curve for a more complicated data set，elbow 未必明顯）。

6.5 Framework for Cluster Validity (Slides 79–81)

  • Need a framework to interpret any measure：例如 evaluation measure = 10，係 good、fair 定 poor？
  • Statistics provide a framework：The more "atypical" a clustering result is, the more likely it represents valid structure in the data。
  • 將 index 值同 random data / random clusterings 嘅 index 值比較；if the value of the index is unlikely, then the cluster results are valid。（較複雜、較難理解。）
  • 比較兩組 cluster analyses 時 framework 較唔需要，但仍有「兩個 index 值嘅差是否 significant」嘅問題。

Statistical Framework for SSE (slide 80)：例子：compare SSE of 0.005 against three clusters in random data。Histogram 顯示 500 組 random data（每組 100 點，x、y 分佈於 0.2–0.8）分成 3 clusters 嘅 SSE——random data 嘅 SSE 遠大於 0.005，所以 \( SSE = 0.005 \) 嘅 clustering 好 "atypical" → 代表真實結構。

Statistical Framework for Correlation (slide 81)：同樣將 ideal similarity / proximity matrix 嘅 correlation 同 random data 比較。

🔗 跨科連繫

呢個「同 random data 比較，睇結果有幾 unlikely」嘅思路就係 COM6005 hypothesis testing 嘅 p-value 概念：null hypothesis = data 冇 cluster 結構；如果觀察到嘅 SSE 喺 null distribution 下極罕見，就 reject null。

6.6 Internal Measures: Cohesion and Separation (Slides 82–84)

  • Cluster Cohesion：measures how closely related are objects in a cluster（例：SSE）。
  • Cluster Separation：measure how distinct or well-separated a cluster is from other clusters（例：squared error between clusters）。
⭐ 考試重點：SSE (WSS) 同 SSB (BSS)

Cohesion is measured by the within cluster sum of squares (SSE)：

$$ SSE = WSS = \sum_i \sum_{x \in C_i} (x - m_i)^2 $$

Separation is measured by the between cluster sum of squares：

$$ SSB = BSS = \sum_i |C_i|\,(m - m_i)^2 $$

\(|C_i|\) 係 cluster \( i \) 嘅 size，\(m_i\) 係 cluster centroid，\(m\) 係全部 data 嘅 overall mean。\( SSE + SSB = \) 常數（Total Sum of Squares, TSS）。

Worked example（一維 points 1, 2, 4, 5；overall mean \( m = 3 \)）：

  • \( K = 1 \)：\( SSE = (1-3)^2 + (2-3)^2 + (4-3)^2 + (5-3)^2 = 4+1+1+4 = \) 10；\( SSB = 4 \times (3-3)^2 = \) 0；Total = 10
  • \( K = 2 \)：clusters {1, 2}（\(m_1 = 1.5\)）同 {4, 5}（\(m_2 = 4.5\)）：\( SSE = 0.25+0.25+0.25+0.25 = \) 1；\( SSB = 2(3-1.5)^2 + 2(4.5-3)^2 = 4.5 + 4.5 = \) 9；Total = 10 ✓

好嘅 clustering：SSE 細（cohesion 高）、SSB 大（separation 高）。

Proximity graph based approach (slide 84)：Cluster cohesion is the sum of the weight of all links within a cluster；cluster separation is the sum of the weights between nodes in the cluster and nodes outside the cluster。

🔗 跨科連繫

\( SSE + SSB = TSS \) 同 COM6005 ANOVA / regression 嘅 \( SST = SSW + SSB \)（或 \( SSE + SSR \)）係同一個分解。

6.7 Internal Measures: Silhouette Coefficient (Slide 85)

Silhouette coefficient combines ideas of both cohesion and separation，可以用於 individual points、clusters 同 clusterings。

⭐ 考試重點：Silhouette 計法

對一個 individual point \(i\)：

  • a = average distance of \(i\) to the points in its cluster（cohesion）
  • b = min (average distance of \(i\) to points in another cluster)（對每個其他 cluster 計平均距離，取最細）
$$ s = \frac{b - a}{\max(a, b)} $$

Typically between 0 and 1；the closer to 1 the better（理論範圍 −1 至 1；負數表示該點可能分錯 cluster）。可以計一個 cluster 或成個 clustering 嘅 average silhouette coefficient。

💡 Worked example（用 §5.4 distance matrix，clustering = {a, b}、{c, d, e}）

Point a：\( a = d(a, b) = 2 \)；\( b = \text{avg}(d(a,c), d(a,d), d(a,e)) = (6+10+9)/3 = 8.33 \)；\( s = (8.33 - 2)/8.33 = \) 0.76

Point c：\( a = \text{avg}(d(c,d), d(c,e)) = (4+5)/2 = 4.5 \)；\( b = \text{avg}(d(c,a), d(c,b)) = (6+5)/2 = 5.5 \)；\( s = (5.5 - 4.5)/5.5 = \) 0.18（c 喺兩個 clusters 之間，silhouette 低）

Point d：\( a = (4+3)/2 = 3.5 \)；\( b = (10+9)/2 = 9.5 \)；\( s = 6/9.5 = \) 0.63

如果某點 \( a > b \)（離自己 cluster 比另一 cluster 更遠），s 會係負數 → 應考慮重新分配。

from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score, silhouette_samples
silhouette_samples(D, labels=[0,0,1,1,1], metric="precomputed")   # 每點 s
silhouette_score(X, km.labels_)                                     # 整體平均

7. Density Based Clustering: DBSCAN (Optional)

Slide 86：Clusters are regions of high density that are separated from one another by regions of low density。

⭐ 考試重點（optional 部分仍可能考概念）：DBSCAN 定義 (Slide 87)
  • Density = number of points within a specified radius (Eps)
  • Core point：has at least a specified number of points (MinPts) within Eps（counts the point itself）；these are points at the interior of a cluster
  • Border point：is not a core point, but is in the neighborhood of a core point
  • Noise point：any point that is not a core point or a border point

Slides 88–89 例子圖：MinPts = 7 示意；Eps = 10, MinPts = 4 時 original points 被標記為 core、border、noise。

7.1 DBSCAN Algorithm (Slide 90)

Form clusters using core points, and assign border points to one of its neighboring clusters：

  1. Label all points as core, border, or noise points。
  2. Eliminate noise points。
  3. Put an edge between all core points within a distance Eps of each other。
  4. Make each group of connected core points into a separate cluster。
  5. Assign each border point to one of the clusters of its associated core points。
💡 Worked example（自擬，一維）

Points：1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 9, 20；Eps = 1.5，MinPts = 3（包括自己）。

  • 1：Eps 內有 {1, 2} = 2 點 → 唔係 core；但 2 係 core 且 |1−2| ≤ 1.5 → border
  • 2：{1, 2, 3} = 3 → core
  • 3：{2, 3, 4} = 3 → core
  • 4：{3, 4} = 2 → 唔係 core；鄰近 core 3 → border
  • 8：{8, 9} = 2；9：{8, 9} = 2；兩者都唔係 core，亦冇 core 鄰居 → noise
  • 20：{20} → noise

Core 2 同 3 距離 1 ≤ Eps → 連埋做一個 cluster；border 1、4 加入 → Cluster = {1, 2, 3, 4}；Noise = {8, 9, 20}。
如果 MinPts 改為 2，8 同 9 都會變 core，形成第二個 cluster {8, 9}——結果對參數好敏感。

7.2 When DBSCAN Works / Does NOT Work Well (Slides 91–92)

Works wellDoes NOT work well
  • Can handle clusters of different shapes and sizes
  • Resistant to noise
  • Varying densities（slide 92：MinPts = 4，Eps = 9.92 vs 9.75 結果差好遠——一個 Eps 唔能夠同時適合密同疏嘅 clusters）
  • High-dimensional data（curse of dimensionality 令 density 定義失效）

7.3 Determining Eps and MinPts (Slide 93)

  • Idea：for points in a cluster, their k-th nearest neighbors are at close distance；noise points have the k-th nearest neighbor at farther distance。
  • So, plot sorted distance of every point to its k-th nearest neighbor（k-distance plot）；曲線急升嘅 "knee" 位置就係 Eps 嘅好選擇，k 就做 MinPts。
from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors
from sklearn.cluster import DBSCAN
k = 4
dist, _ = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=k).fit(X).kneighbors(X)
plt.plot(np.sort(dist[:, -1]))                  # k-distance plot，搵 knee → Eps
labels = DBSCAN(eps=1.5, min_samples=3).fit_predict(np.array([1,2,3,4,8,9,20]).reshape(-1,1))
# labels: [0 0 0 0 -1 -1 -1]   (-1 = noise)
⭐ 考試重點：三種方法總比較
K-meansAgglomerative HierarchicalDBSCAN
TypePartitional, center-basedHierarchical (nested)Partitional, density-based
要預設K唔使（cut dendrogram）；要揀 linkageEps、MinPts
ShapesGlobular onlyMIN：任意；MAX / Avg：globular任意形狀同大小
Noise / outliers敏感MIN 敏感；MAX / Avg 較 robustResistant（標記為 noise）
Complexity\(O(n\cdot K\cdot I\cdot d)\)\(O(N^2)\) space，\(O(N^3)\) time（教科書：\(O(N^2)\)，有 index 可更快）
主要弱點Initial centroids、sizes、densities、shapesMerge 唔可以 undo；冇 global objectiveVarying densities、high-dimensional

自我測驗 Self-test

Q1. Points：1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 15；\( K = 2 \)；initial centroids 1 同 8。做 K-means 直到收斂，並計最終 SSE。

Iter 1：\( C_1 = \{1, 2\} \)（2：|2−1| = 1 < 6），\( C_2 = \{6, 7, 8, 15\} \)（6：5 > 2）→ \(c_1 = 1.5\)，\(c_2 = 36/4 = 9\)。
Iter 2：6：|6−1.5| = 4.5 > |6−9| = 3 → \(C_2\)；assignments 冇變 → converged。
\( SSE = (1-1.5)^2 + (2-1.5)^2 + (6-9)^2 + (7-9)^2 + (8-9)^2 + (15-9)^2 = 0.25 + 0.25 + 9 + 4 + 1 + 36 = \) 50.5。
（如果 \( K = 3 \) 用 {1,2}、{6,7,8}、{15}，\( SSE = 0.5 + 2 + 0 = 2.5 \)，明顯好啲——15 係 outlier 拉走咗 centroid。）

Q2. 點解唔可以揀令 SSE 最細嘅 K？應該點揀？

因為 SSE 隨 K 增加而下降，\( K = n \) 時 \( SSE = 0 \)，所以「最細 SSE」永遠揀最大 K。應用 SSE vs K 曲線搵 elbow / knee，或用 silhouette coefficient、或同 random data 比較（statistical framework）。

Q3. 有 5 個大小相同嘅真實 clusters，隨機揀 5 個 initial centroids，每個 cluster 剛好一個嘅概率係幾多？

\( P = K!/K^K = 5!/5^5 = 120/3125 = \) 0.0384。（\( K = 10 \) 時只有 0.00036。）

Q4. Distance matrix（\( p_1 \)–\( p_4 \)）：\( d_{12} = 1 \), \( d_{13} = 4 \), \( d_{14} = 5 \), \( d_{23} = 3 \), \( d_{24} = 6 \), \( d_{34} = 2 \)。用 MIN 同 MAX 做 agglomerative clustering，寫出每步 merge 嘅高度。

Step 1：merge {p1, p2} @1。
MIN：\( d(\{12\}, 3) = \min(4, 3) = 3 \)；\( d(\{12\}, 4) = \min(5, 6) = 5 \)；\( d(3, 4) = 2 \) → merge {p3, p4} @2；最後 \( d(\{12\}, \{34\}) = \min(4, 5, 3, 6) = 3 \) → @3。
MAX：\( d(\{12\}, 3) = 4 \)；\( d(\{12\}, 4) = 6 \)；\( d(3, 4) = 2 \) → merge {p3, p4} @2；最後 max(4, 5, 3, 6) = 6 → @6。
Group Average 最後一步 = (4+5+3+6)/4 = 4.5。

Q5. 比較 MIN 同 MAX linkage 嘅優缺點。

MIN：可以處理 non-elliptical shapes，但對 noise / outliers 敏感（chaining effect）。MAX：較唔受 noise 影響，但傾向打散大 clusters，同偏向 globular clusters。Group Average 係兩者折衷（less susceptible to noise，但 biased towards globular）。

Q6. 用 Q4 嘅 distance matrix，clustering = {p1, p2}、{p3, p4}。計 p2 同 p3 嘅 silhouette coefficient。

p2：\( a = d(p_2, p_1) = 1 \)；\( b = \text{avg}(d_{23}, d_{24}) = (3 + 6)/2 = 4.5 \)；\( s = (4.5 - 1)/4.5 = \) 0.778。
p3：\( a = d(p_3, p_4) = 2 \)；\( b = \text{avg}(d_{31}, d_{32}) = (4 + 3)/2 = 3.5 \)；\( s = (3.5 - 2)/3.5 = \) 0.429。

Q7. 一維 points 2, 4, 10, 12，clusters {2, 4} 同 {10, 12}。計 SSE、SSB 同 total，並驗證 \( SSE + SSB = TSS \)。

Overall mean = 7；\(m_1 = 3\)，\(m_2 = 11\)。\( SSE = 1+1+1+1 = \) 4；\( SSB = 2(7-3)^2 + 2(11-7)^2 = 32 + 32 = \) 64；\( TSS = 25+9+9+25 = 68 = 4 + 64 \) ✓。

Q8. DBSCAN：定義 core、border、noise point。點解 DBSCAN 處理唔到 varying densities？

Core：Eps 半徑內（包括自己）有 ≥ MinPts 點；Border：唔係 core 但喺某 core point 嘅 Eps neighborhood 內；Noise：既唔係 core 亦唔係 border。因為成個 data set 只用一組 Eps / MinPts：Eps 細到可以分開密 clusters 時，疏 cluster 嘅點會變 noise；Eps 大到可以容納疏 cluster 時，相鄰嘅密 clusters 會被合併。

Q9. 列出 K-means 嘅 pre-processing 同 post-processing 步驟。

Pre：normalize the data；eliminate outliers。Post：eliminate small clusters（可能係 outliers）；split loose clusters（high SSE）；merge close clusters with relatively low SSE。

Q10. Hierarchical clustering 嘅 space 同 time complexity？有咩主要限制？

\(O(N^2)\) space（proximity matrix）；\(O(N^3)\) time（N 步，每步更新 / 搜尋 \(N^2\) matrix），聰明實作可減到 \(O(N^2 \log N)\)。限制：merge 決定唔可以 undo；冇直接 minimize global objective function；唔同 linkage 有 noise 敏感、處理唔到唔同大小 / non-globular、打散大 cluster 等問題。

一頁總結 Cheat sheet

⭐ 考前速記
  • Cluster analysis：組內相似（intra ↓）、組間唔同（inter ↑）；用途 understanding、summarization；cluster 數目 ambiguous。
  • Partitional（non-overlapping，每點一個 cluster）vs Hierarchical（nested，dendrogram）；exclusive / non-exclusive、fuzzy（weights sum to 1）、partial / complete、heterogeneous / homogeneous。
  • Cluster types：well-separated、center-based（centroid / medoid）、contiguity-based（transitive）、density-based（irregular + noise）。
  • K-means：揀 K 個 initial centroids → assign to closest → recompute mean → repeat until no change。\(O(n\cdot K\cdot I\cdot d)\)。Random init → 每次結果唔同。
  • SSE = \( \sum\sum \text{dist}^2(m_i, x) \)；mean 令 SSE 最細；增加 K 一定減 SSE。
  • Initial centroids：P(每 cluster 一個) = \( K!/K^K \)（\( K = 10 \) → 0.00036）；solutions：multiple runs、hierarchical on sample、多啲 clusters 再 merge、揀多過 k 再揀 widely separated、K-means++（prob \( \propto D(x)^2 \)，\( O(\log k) \)）。
  • K-means limitations：differing sizes、densities、non-globular shapes、outliers → 用多啲 clusters 再 post-process merge；pre（normalize、remove outliers）、post（remove small、split high-SSE、merge close low-SSE）。
  • Hierarchical：唔使預設 K（cut dendrogram）、可對應 taxonomy；agglomerative（merge closest）vs divisive（split）。
  • Linkage：MIN（closest pair；non-elliptical ✓、noise ✗）、MAX（farthest pair；noise ✓、breaks large、globular bias）、Group Average（\( \sum d / (|C_i||C_j|) \)；折衷）、Centroid distance。
  • Complexity：\(O(N^2)\) space、\(O(N^3)\) time（可到 \(O(N^2 \log N)\)）；merge 唔可以 undo、冇 global objective。
  • Validity：避免喺 noise 搵 pattern；aspects：clustering tendency、external labels、internal（只用 data）、比較兩組、揀 K。
  • Correlation：ideal similarity matrix（同 cluster = 1）vs proximity matrix，計 \( n(n-1)/2 \) entries；唔適合 density / contiguity clusters。Similarity matrix 按 label 排序睇方塊；random data 唔 crisp。
  • SSE vs K 搵 elbow；statistical framework：同 random data 嘅 index 分佈比較（SSE 0.005 例子）。
  • Cohesion = SSE (WSS)；Separation = \( SSB = \sum |C_i|(m - m_i)^2 \)；\( SSE + SSB = \) 常數（1,2,4,5 例：\( K=1 \) → 10 + 0；\( K=2 \) → 1 + 9）。
  • Silhouette：a = 同 cluster 平均距離；b = 最近其他 cluster 嘅平均距離；\( s = (b - a)/\max(a, b) \)；越近 1 越好。
  • DBSCAN：Eps、MinPts（包括自己）；core / border / noise；連接 Eps 內嘅 core points 成 clusters，border 歸附近 core 嘅 cluster；✓ 任意形狀大小、resistant to noise；✗ varying densities、high-dimensional；k-distance plot 揀 Eps。

17. Python 示範（自己加，唔喺 slides）

html:
🎯 本講重點 (Learning outcomes)

  • 定義：itemset、k-itemset、support count \( \sigma \)、support \( s \)、frequent itemset、association rule \( X \rightarrow Y \)、confidence \( c \)。
  • Brute-force 點解唔得：\( 2^d \) 個 itemsets、\( 3^d - 2^{d+1} + 1 \) 條 rules；改用 two-step approach（frequent itemset generation → rule generation）。
  • Apriori principle（anti-monotone property of support）、Apriori algorithm、candidate generation（\( F_{k-1} \times F_{k-1} \)）、candidate pruning、support counting（hash tree）。
  • Rule generation：\( 2^k - 2 \) 條 candidate rules；confidence 對 RHS item 數目係 anti-monotone。
  • Compact representation：maximal frequent itemset vs closed itemset。
  • Pattern evaluation：contingency table、confidence 嘅缺點、lift / interest、PS、φ-coefficient；measures 嘅 properties（symmetry、scaling、inversion、null addition）；Simpson's paradox。

⭐ 考試必溫 Top-5

  1. 由 transaction table 計 support 同 confidence：\( s(X \rightarrow Y) = \frac{\sigma(X \cup Y)}{|T|} \)，\( c(X \rightarrow Y) = \frac{\sigma(X \cup Y)}{\sigma(X)} \)。
  2. Apriori principle：frequent itemset 嘅所有 subsets 都 frequent ⇔ infrequent itemset 嘅所有 supersets 都 infrequent；識行 Apriori（minsup = 3 嘅 Bread/Milk/Diaper 例子，6 + 6 + 1 = 13）。
  3. \( F_{k-1} \times F_{k-1} \) merge（頭 \( k-2 \) 個 items 相同）＋ candidate pruning（任何一個 \( (k-1) \)-subset infrequent 就刪）。
  4. Maximal vs closed：識喺 transaction grid 搵出 frequent / maximal / closed itemsets；Maximal ⊆ Closed ⊆ Frequent。
  5. Lift / Interest \( = \frac{P(X, Y)}{P(X)P(Y)} \)：> 1 正相關、= 1 independent、< 1 負相關（Tea → Coffee：0.9375）；Simpson's paradox（hospital / county 例子）。

1. Association Rule Mining：問題定義

Given a set of transactions, find rules that will predict the occurrence of an item based on the occurrences of other items in the transaction。經典應用係 market-basket analysis：超市收銀紀錄入面，買咗某啲貨品嘅人仲會買乜。

成章用嘅 market-basket transactions（slide 4，由 slide 圖片 EMF 內嘅文字還原）：

TIDItems
1Bread, Milk
2Bread, Diaper, Beer, Eggs
3Milk, Diaper, Beer, Coke
4Bread, Milk, Diaper, Beer
5Bread, Milk, Diaper, Coke
⚠️ 易混淆

Association rule 代表 co-occurrence，唔代表 causality。{Diaper} → {Beer} 只話「買尿片嘅交易通常都有啤酒」，唔係話買尿片導致買啤酒。

2. Definitions：Itemset、Support、Association Rule

⭐ 考試重點：定義
  • Itemset：A collection of one or more items，例如 {Milk, Bread, Diaper}。
  • k-itemset：An itemset that contains k items。
  • Support count \( \sigma \)：itemset 出現嘅次數（frequency of occurrence），例如 \( \sigma(\{\text{Milk, Bread, Diaper}\}) = 2 \)（TID 4、5）。
  • Support \( s \)：含該 itemset 嘅 transactions 嘅比例，例如 \( s(\{\text{Milk, Bread, Diaper}\}) = 2/5 \)。
  • Frequent itemset：support ≥ minsup threshold 嘅 itemset。
  • Association rule：形式為 \( X \rightarrow Y \) 嘅 implication expression，\( X \)、\( Y \) 係 itemsets（而且 \( X \cap Y = \emptyset \)），例如 {Milk, Diaper} → {Beer}。

Rule evaluation metrics：

$$ s(X \rightarrow Y) = \frac{\sigma(X \cup Y)}{|T|} \qquad c(X \rightarrow Y) = \frac{\sigma(X \cup Y)}{\sigma(X)} $$
  • Support (s)：Fraction of transactions that contain both X and Y。
  • Confidence (c)：Measures how often items in Y appear in transactions that contain X。

例子：{Milk, Diaper} → {Beer}：\( s = \frac{\sigma(\{\text{Milk, Diaper, Beer}\})}{5} = \frac{2}{5} = 0.4 \)，\( c = \frac{\sigma(\{\text{Milk, Diaper, Beer}\})}{\sigma(\{\text{Milk, Diaper}\})} = \frac{2}{3} = 0.67 \)。

💡 直覺理解

Support 答「呢個組合有幾常見」（太少見嘅 rule 可能只係巧合，亦冇商業價值）；confidence 答「已知有 X，有 Y 嘅條件機率」，即 \( P(Y \mid X) \)。

3. Mining Task 與 Computational Complexity

Given a set of transactions T，association rule mining 嘅目標係搵出所有：support ≥ minsup threshold 同 confidence ≥ minconf threshold 嘅 rules。

Brute-force approach：列出所有可能 rules → 計每條嘅 support 同 confidence → prune 走唔過 minsup / minconf 嘅 → Computationally prohibitive!

⭐ 考試重點：Complexity 公式

Given \( d \) unique items：

  • Total number of itemsets \( = 2^d \)
  • Total number of possible association rules：
$$ R = \sum_{k=1}^{d-1} \left[ \binom{d}{k} \times \sum_{j=1}^{d-k} \binom{d-k}{j} \right] = 3^d - 2^{d+1} + 1 $$

If \( d = 6 \)：\( R = 3^6 - 2^7 + 1 = 729 - 128 + 1 = 602 \) rules。

💡 點解係 \( 3^d \)？

每個 item 有 3 個選擇：放 LHS、放 RHS、或者唔用 → \( 3^d \)。再減走 LHS 空（\( 2^d \) 種）同 RHS 空（\( 2^d \) 種），兩邊都空嗰種被減咗兩次，加返 1：\( 3^d - 2 \cdot 2^d + 1 \)。Slide 8 個圖顯示 \( d \) 由 2 到 10，rules 數目以指數增長（\( d = 10 \) 已接近 57,000）。

Mining Association Rules：觀察

由 itemset {Milk, Diaper, Beer} 產生嘅 rules：

Rulesc
{Milk, Diaper} → {Beer}0.40.67
{Milk, Beer} → {Diaper}0.41.0
{Diaper, Beer} → {Milk}0.40.67
{Beer} → {Milk, Diaper}0.40.67
{Diaper} → {Milk, Beer}0.40.5
{Milk} → {Diaper, Beer}0.40.5
⭐ 考試重點：Observations
  • 以上全部係同一個 itemset {Milk, Diaper, Beer} 嘅 binary partitions。
  • 同一個 itemset 產生嘅 rules support 一樣，但 confidence 可以唔同（分母 \( \sigma(X) \) 唔同）。
  • 所以可以 decouple support 同 confidence 嘅要求 → Two-step approach：
    1. Frequent Itemset Generation：搵出所有 support ≥ minsup 嘅 itemsets。
    2. Rule Generation：由每個 frequent itemset 產生 high confidence rules，每條 rule 係 frequent itemset 嘅一個 binary partitioning。
  • Frequent itemset generation 仍然 computationally expensive。

4. Frequent Itemset Generation

Given \( d \) items，有 \( 2^d \) 個 possible candidate itemsets（slide 11 嘅 itemset lattice：由 null 到 A…E、AB…DE、一直到 ABCDE，5 個 items 共 32 個 nodes）。

Brute-force approach：lattice 入面每個 itemset 都係 candidate frequent itemset；scan database 計每個 candidate 嘅 support，每個 transaction 要同每個 candidate match。

$$ \text{Complexity} \sim O(NMw) $$

\( N \) = number of transactions，\( M \) = number of candidates，\( w \) = maximum transaction width。Expensive since \( M = 2^d \)!!!

⭐ 考試重點：Frequent itemset generation strategies
Reduce…做法
Number of candidates (\( M \))Complete search：\( M = 2^d \)；用 pruning techniques 減少 \( M \)（Apriori）
Number of transactions (\( N \))Itemset size 增加時減少 \( N \)；DHP 同 vertical-based mining algorithms 用
Number of comparisons (\( NM \))用 efficient data structures 儲 candidates 或 transactions，唔使每個 candidate 同每個 transaction 都 match（hash tree）

5. Apriori Principle

⭐ 考試重點

Apriori principle：If an itemset is frequent, then all of its subsets must also be frequent。

成立原因：support measure 有以下 property——Support of an itemset never exceeds the support of its subsets。即：

$$ \forall X, Y : (X \subseteq Y) \Rightarrow s(X) \geq s(Y) $$

呢個叫 support 嘅 anti-monotone property。

💡 直覺理解：反過嚟用先有用

Contrapositive：如果一個 itemset infrequent，佢所有 supersets 都一定 infrequent。所以喺 lattice 一發現 {A,B} infrequent，所有含 A、B 嘅 itemsets（ABC、ABD、…、ABCDE）全部可以 prune 走，唔使計（slide 15：「Found to be Infrequent → Pruned supersets」）。

Illustrating Apriori Principle（minsup = 3）

Items (1-itemsets) count（用 Section 1 嘅 5 transactions）：

ItemCount
Bread4
Coke2 ✗
Milk4
Beer3
Diaper4
Eggs1 ✗

Coke 同 Eggs infrequent → No need to generate candidates involving Coke or Eggs。Pairs (2-itemsets)：只由 4 個 frequent items 組合，\( \binom{4}{2} = 6 \) 個：

ItemsetCount
{Bread, Milk}3
{Bread, Beer}2 ✗
{Bread, Diaper}3
{Milk, Beer}2 ✗
{Milk, Diaper}3
{Beer, Diaper}3

Triplets (3-itemsets)：slide 21 列出 4 個 candidates：{Beer, Diaper, Milk} 2、{Beer, Bread, Diaper} 2、{Bread, Diaper, Milk} 2、{Beer, Bread, Milk} 1——全部 < 3，冇 frequent 3-itemset。

⭐ 考試重點：數 candidates
  • If every subset is considered：\( \binom{6}{1} + \binom{6}{2} + \binom{6}{3} = 6 + 15 + 20 = 41 \)
  • With support-based pruning：\( 6 + 6 + 4 = 16 \)（slide 16–21）
  • 再用 Apriori 嘅 candidate pruning（任何 2-subset infrequent 就刪）：\( 6 + 6 + 1 = 13 \)（slide 22）——4 個 triplets 之中，只有 {Bread, Diaper, Milk} 嘅三個 pairs 全部 frequent；其餘三個都含 {Bread, Beer} 或 {Milk, Beer}。

6. Apriori Algorithm

⭐ 考試重點：Algorithm steps

\( F_k \)：frequent k-itemsets；\( L_k \)：candidate k-itemsets

  1. Let \( k = 1 \)
  2. Generate \( F_1 \) = {frequent 1-itemsets}
  3. Repeat until \( F_k \) is empty：
    • Candidate Generation：Generate \( L_{k+1} \) from \( F_k \)
    • Candidate Pruning：Prune candidate itemsets in \( L_{k+1} \) containing subsets of length \( k \) that are infrequent
    • Support Counting：Count the support of each candidate in \( L_{k+1} \) by scanning the DB
    • Candidate Elimination：Eliminate candidates in \( L_{k+1} \) that are infrequent, leaving only those that are frequent ⇒ \( F_{k+1} \)
⚠️ 易混淆：Pruning vs Elimination

Candidate pruning 唔使 scan database，只係睇 \( F_k \)：candidate 有某個 k-subset 唔喺 \( F_k \) 就刪。Candidate elimination 要 scan database 數 support 之後，先刪 support < minsup 嘅。Pruning 喺 counting 之前做，目的係減少要數嘅 candidates。

Candidate Generation 方法

  • Brute-force method（slide 24）：由 items 組合所有可能 k-itemsets，再 prune——candidates 太多。
  • Merge \( F_{k-1} \) and \( F_1 \) itemsets（slide 25）：每個 frequent \( (k-1) \)-itemset 加一個 frequent item。
🖼️ 圖片內容

Slide 24、25、28 嘅例子係圖片，文字擷取不到；請對照原 slide。

⭐ 考試重點：\( F_{k-1} \times F_{k-1} \) Method

Merge two frequent \( (k-1) \)-itemsets if their first \( (k-2) \) items are identical（items 要按 lexicographic order 排好）。

\( F_3 \) = {ABC, ABD, ABE, ACD, BCD, BDE, CDE}

  • Merge(ABC, ABD) = ABCD
  • Merge(ABC, ABE) = ABCE
  • Merge(ABD, ABE) = ABDE
  • Do not merge(ABD, ACD) because they share only prefix of length 1 instead of length 2

Candidate pruning：\( L_4 \) = {ABCD, ABCE, ABDE}

  • Prune ABCE because ACE and BCE are infrequent
  • Prune ABDE because ADE is infrequent
  • After candidate pruning：\( L_4 \) = {ABCD}（ABCD 嘅 subsets ABC、ABD、ACD、BCD 全部喺 \( F_3 \)）

回到超市例子（slide 29）：frequent pairs 按字母排係 {Beer, Diaper}、{Bread, Diaper}、{Bread, Milk}、{Diaper, Milk}。只有 {Bread, Diaper} 同 {Bread, Milk} 嘅第一個 item 相同 → 只產生 一個 3-itemset {Bread, Diaper, Milk}，support count = 2 < 3，喺 support counting 之後被 eliminate。所以 \( 6 + 6 + 1 = 13 \)。

Alternate \( F_{k-1} \times F_{k-1} \) Method

Merge two frequent \( (k-1) \)-itemsets if the last \( (k-2) \) items of the first one is identical to the first \( (k-2) \) items of the second。

\( F_3 \) = {ABC, ABD, ABE, ACD, BCD, BDE, CDE}

  • Merge(ABC, BCD) = ABCD
  • Merge(ABD, BDE) = ABDE
  • Merge(ACD, CDE) = ACDE
  • Merge(BCD, CDE) = BCDE

Candidate pruning：\( L_4 \) = {ABCD, ABDE, ACDE, BCDE}

  • Prune ABDE because ADE is infrequent
  • Prune ACDE because ACE and ADE are infrequent
  • Prune BCDE because BCE is infrequent
  • After candidate pruning：\( L_4 \) = {ABCD}
💡 直覺理解

兩種 merge 方法產生嘅 candidates 唔同（第一種 3 個，alternate 4 個），但經過 candidate pruning 之後結果一樣（{ABCD}）。兩種都 complete（唔會漏 frequent itemset），亦避免重複產生同一個 candidate。

7. Support Counting 與 Hash Tree

Scan database 決定每個 candidate 嘅 support：每個 candidate 都要同每個 transaction match，代價好高。

改善：將 candidate itemsets 儲喺 hash structure，每個 transaction 只同 hashed buckets 入面嘅 candidates match，唔使同每個 candidate 比較。

⭐ 考試重點：Hash tree 例子

15 個 candidate 3-itemsets：{1 4 5}, {1 2 4}, {4 5 7}, {1 2 5}, {4 5 8}, {1 5 9}, {1 3 6}, {2 3 4}, {5 6 7}, {3 4 5}, {3 5 6}, {3 5 7}, {6 8 9}, {3 6 7}, {3 6 8}。

問：transaction (1, 2, 3, 5, 6) support 幾多個 candidates？

需要：

  • Hash function：1, 4, 7 → 左 branch；2, 5, 8 → 中 branch；3, 6, 9 → 右 branch（即 item mod 3）。Level 1 hash 第 1 個 item，Level 2 hash 第 2 個，Level 3 hash 第 3 個。
  • Max leaf size：一個 leaf node 最多儲幾多個 itemsets；超過就 split node。

Transaction 嘅 3-subsets（\( \binom{5}{3} = 10 \) 個）：123, 125, 126, 135, 136, 156, 235, 236, 256, 356。逐層 enumerate：1 + 2 3 5 6、2 + 3 5 6、3 + 5 6，再分 1 2 + 3 5 6、1 3 + 5 6、1 5 + 6 等，只去對應嘅 leaf。

結果：Match transaction against 11 out of 15 candidates（唔使比較全部 15 個）；當中真正被 support 嘅係 {1 2 5}、{1 3 6}、{3 5 6} = 3 個。

8. Rule Generation

⭐ 考試重點

Given a frequent itemset \( L \)，find all non-empty subsets \( f \subset L \) such that \( f \rightarrow L - f \) satisfies the minimum confidence requirement。

If {A,B,C,D} is a frequent itemset，candidate rules：

ABC→D, ABD→C, ACD→B, BCD→A,
A→BCD, B→ACD, C→ABD, D→ABC,
AB→CD, AC→BD, AD→BC, BC→AD, BD→AC, CD→AB

If \( |L| = k \)，then there are \( 2^k - 2 \) candidate association rules（ignoring \( L \rightarrow \emptyset \) and \( \emptyset \rightarrow L \)）。上例 \( 2^4 - 2 = 14 \)。

Confidence 嘅 anti-monotone property

  • 一般而言，confidence 冇 anti-monotone property：\( c(ABC \rightarrow D) \) 可以大過或者細過 \( c(AB \rightarrow D) \)。
  • 但同一個 itemset 產生嘅 rules，confidence 有 anti-monotone property。例如 {A,B,C,D} 係 frequent 4-itemset：
$$ c(ABC \rightarrow D) \geq c(AB \rightarrow CD) \geq c(A \rightarrow BCD) $$

Exam Confidence is anti-monotone w.r.t. number of items on the RHS of the rule。

💡 點解？

三條 rule 分子都係 \( \sigma(ABCD) \)；分母分別係 \( \sigma(ABC) \leq \sigma(AB) \leq \sigma(A) \)（support anti-monotone）。分母越大，confidence 越細。所以將 items 由 LHS 搬去 RHS，confidence 只會跌或者唔變。

Lattice of rules（slide 44）：頂層係 ABCD⇒{ }，下一層 BCD⇒A、ACD⇒B、ABD⇒C、ABC⇒D，再落係 RHS 有 2 個 items、3 個 items 嘅 rules。如果某條 rule（例如 BCD⇒A）低 confidence，佢下面所有 RHS 包含 A 嘅 rules（CD⇒AB、BD⇒AC、BC⇒AD、D⇒ABC、C⇒ABD、B⇒ACD）都可以 prune。

12. Pattern Evaluation 與 Contingency Table

  • Association rule algorithms 會產生大量 rules。
  • Interestingness measures 可以用嚟 prune / rank patterns。
  • In the original formulation，support & confidence 係唯一用嘅 measures。

Given \( X \rightarrow Y \) 或 {X, Y}，計 interestingness 所需資訊可以由 contingency table 得到：

\( Y \)\( \overline{Y} \)
\( X \)\( f_{11} \)\( f_{10} \)\( f_{1+} \)
\( \overline{X} \)\( f_{01} \)\( f_{00} \)\( f_{0+} \)
\( f_{+1} \)\( f_{+0} \)\( N \)

\( f_{11} \)：support of X and Y；\( f_{10} \)：support of X and \( \overline{Y} \)；\( f_{01} \)：support of \( \overline{X} \) and Y；\( f_{00} \)：support of \( \overline{X} \) and \( \overline{Y} \)。用嚟定義 support、confidence、Gini、entropy 等 measures。

🔗 跨科連繫

呢個 2×2 contingency table 同 COM6005 Module 3b Chi-square test of independence 用嘅 table 完全一樣；Gini、entropy 就係 COM6004 Chapter 3 decision tree 嘅 impurity measures。

14. Statistical Independence 與 Lift / Interest

條件 confidence(X → Y) = support(Y) 等價於：

$$ P(Y \mid X) = P(Y) \iff P(X, Y) = P(X) \times P(Y) \quad (X \text{ and } Y \text{ are independent}) $$
  • If \( P(X, Y) > P(X) \times P(Y) \)：X & Y are positively correlated
  • If \( P(X, Y) < P(X) \times P(Y) \)：X & Y are negatively correlated
⭐ 考試重點：Measures that take into account statistical dependence（slide 75）
$$ \text{Lift} = \frac{P(Y \mid X)}{P(Y)} \qquad \text{Interest} = \frac{P(X, Y)}{P(X)P(Y)} $$
$$ PS = P(X, Y) - P(X)P(Y) $$
$$ \phi\text{-coefficient} = \frac{P(X, Y) - P(X)P(Y)}{\sqrt{P(X)[1 - P(X)]\,P(Y)[1 - P(Y)]}} $$

Lift is used for rules while interest is used for itemsets（兩者數值相同，因為 \( \frac{P(Y \mid X)}{P(Y)} = \frac{P(X, Y)}{P(X)P(Y)} \)）。

Lift = 1：independent；> 1：positively associated；< 1：negatively associated。

例子：Tea → Coffee：Interest \( = \frac{0.15}{0.2 \times 0.8} = 0.9375 \)（< 1，therefore is negatively associated）。

Property under Variable Permutation（symmetry）

將 contingency table 嘅 A、B 對調（transpose），\( M(A, B) = M(B, A) \) 嗎？

  • Symmetric measures：support、lift、collective strength、cosine、Jaccard 等
  • Asymmetric measures：confidence、conviction、Laplace、J-measure 等
💡 用途

Symmetric measures 適合評估 itemsets；asymmetric measures 適合評估 rules（因為 X → Y 同 Y → X 意義唔同，例如 confidence \( P(Y \mid X) \neq P(X \mid Y) \)）。
